'''Kanasana Shrine''' (金鑽神社) refers to shrines with the name "Kanasana."

* [[Kanasana Shrine (Honjo City, Imai)]] - Located in [[Imai (disambiguation)|Imai]], [[Honjō, Saitama|Honjo City]], [[Saitama Prefecture]].
* [[Kanasana Shrine (Honjo City, Kurisaki)]] - Located in Kurisaki, Honjo City, Saitama Prefecture.
* [[Kanasana Shrine]] - Located in Ninomiyama, [[Kamikawa, Saitama|Kamikawa Town]], [[Kodama District, Saitama|Kodama District]], Saitama Prefecture. Known as the 2nd or 5th shrine of [[Musashi Province]], formerly an Imperial Shrine of the Middle Rank
